body: The source-informed mesh-lock trial built successfully but PID17972 still crashed after after_escape_input, before any deferred collision registration. Thus write locking alone is not the crash fix; no terrain-render acceptance changed. Evidence: calibration-crash-17972.json, heightfield-progress-17972.log. Stop varying the same screen initializer without new evidence. Revised alternative: generated native scene bundle in pre-indexed owned slots. Next bounded feasibility test is lossless inspection of an installed terrain container, then a one-height edit verified by native scene load/height query. No arbitrary native terrain writer has yet been proven. Warcraft confirms a custom-map precedent, not per-seed runtime generation. Epic remains incomplete.
